integrity: A complete analytic proof and an exact rational/quadratic-field checker are provided. The finite checker corroborates, but does not substitute for, the infinite-dimensional proof. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is for real first-harmonic sum-angle and separation-angle modulations of a circular Poisson kernel at 0<r<1; the closed cone does not classify higher harmonics, other kernels, or finite sample sizes required to witness every exterior point. Novelty has not been independently certified.
title: The two-obstruction cone for mixed circular Poisson covariance modulation
